Dr. '''Vacca''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who helped to develop the [[Dead Eye Prototype]]. During its production, he was in a dilemma concerning whether he should give the formula to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] or to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the latter of which killed his family in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dr. Vacca was mentioned in SWG, and also appeared on the ''Cries of Alderaan'' badge icons. However, he never actually appeared in the game as a non-player character, despite being referenced in the Prima Official Game Guide as such.
